issue.title: Does not work installed signal if in swoole_process run a sleep(1) function

REASONING: This issue involves a specific behavior in Swoole where signal handling doesn't work properly when using sleep(1) in a swoole_process, but works fine with usleep(1000000). To verify any solution to this issue, one would need to:

1. Set up a PHP environment with Swoole extension (version 4.1.2 or similar)
2. Create a test script that reproduces the signal handling issue with sleep() vs usleep()
3. Apply the proposed solution and verify if signals are properly handled

This is a technical issue related to the runtime behavior of the Swoole extension, specifically how it handles signals during sleep operations. The issue cannot be verified through code analysis alone since it involves the actual execution behavior of the Swoole extension.

While this requires a build environment, it can be easily dockerized by creating a container with PHP 7.2+ and the Swoole extension installed. The issue doesn't depend on special hardware, external services, or complex networking - it's a self-contained behavior that can be reproduced in an isolated environment.
